messages:
maya: FYI nightly-recon surfaced ~38 invoices where NetSuite shows lower total because several line items were dropped during ingest. Looks like large bundle subscriptions with 30+ line items were trimmed to 20 by our parser.

zack_fin: That could under-bill customers if discounts were on the dropped lines. Rough $ impact?

maya: Preliminary total delta ~$3,920 across 38 invoices. Largest single invoice delta $620. I grabbed a sample payload: Stripe sent 32 line items; our consumer only persisted first 20.

sam: Why did we truncate? I thought we preserved all lines. Maybe there is a hard cap in the transformation layer (we added a safety cap a while ago to avoid huge invoices crashing downstream).

ilene_ops: We had a safety limit max_line_items=20 in the NetSuite writer config (added 2025-11 after one merchant sent 400-item invoices). It was silently dropping extras and emitting no error, just a warning. That's the root cause.

maya: Example snippet (sample invoice inv_LargeBundle):

```
"lines": {
  "data": [
    {"id":"li_1","amount":1000,"description":"Feature A"},
    ...
    {"id":"li_32","amount":50,"description":"Addon Z"}
  ]
}
```

NetSuite payload only contained lines 1..20.

zack_fin: Finance: we can approve auto-backfill for totals < $5k. This run qualifies. Please include customer email and invoice id in CSV. Also need an explanation in memo.

sam: Plan:
1) Fix: change writer to fail loudly when truncation would occur (and expose metric `writer.line_item_truncation.count`) and bump max_line_items to 100 for now.
2) Backfill: generate credit memos for missing lines for affected invoices.
3) Add e2e test that creates >20 line invoices and asserts full persistence.

ilene_ops: I'll prepare detection script to find other invoices that hit the truncation guard historically and produce a CSV.

billing-bot: daily-recon job #daily-recon flagged 38 mismatches. Job link: /jobs/11223. Total discrepancy: $3,920. CSV: /secure-drive/finance/lineitem_truncation_2334000000.csv

maya: Dry-run backfill command:

```
python scripts/backfill_lines.py --source stripe --ids /secure-drive/finance/lineitem_truncation_2334000000.csv --dry-run
```

sam: PR opened: https://internal/git/netsuite-writer/pull/721 - change summary: remove silent truncation, bump cap to 100, emit `writer.line_item_truncation.count` and `writer.line_item_truncation.alert` when >0 in prod. Canary plan: staging then 10% prod.

zack_fin: Finance approves backfill for this run. Please attach Stripe event ids to each credit memo and include the change summary for audit.

maya: Dry-run output: 38 records, total credit $3,920. CSV uploaded to /tmp/backfill_dryrun_2334000000.json. Starting backfill with rate 6/s after approvals.

billing-bot: Backfill job started job_id=66543 ETA ~22m. Link: /jobs/66543

ilene_ops: Deployed writer change to staging; staging emitted `writer.line_item_truncation.count` for test invoices and then zero after patch. Rolling to canary now.

sam: Canary logs show INFO: would-have-truncated 34 invoices in last 24h (non-prod), metric nonzero. In prod we'll fail loudly instead of silently dropping.

maya: Backfill finished. Created 38 credit memos. Journal refs uploaded: /secure-drive/finance/lineitem_journals_2334000000.csv. Re-ran daily-recon: affected invoices reconciled cleanly.

zack_fin: Thanks. Filing FIN-560: RCA: cause = silent truncation of invoice line items by NetSuite writer safety cap; fix = fail-loud, bump cap, backfill, metrics, tests. Finance will review full postmortem.

ilene_ops: Added alert: page #finance if `writer.line_item_truncation.count > 0` in prod after rollout. Closing loop after 48h stable.

maya: Will attach PR link, backfill job id, CSVs to FIN-560. Nice catch by nightly-recon :thumbsup:
